content.text:
## Summary

Admin creation flows are reorganized for readability and day-to-day use, without changing CRUD logic or moving admin out of its own section.

### UI changes

**Navigation**
- Sticky tab bar (`Categories | Tasks | Rewards | Punishments | Users`) with clear active state, `role="tab"`, and blur backdrop on scroll (especially on mobile).

**Layout**
- **≥560px:** two columns — searchable list on the left, create/edit form on the right.
- **<560px:** stacked list then form.
- **≥720px:** admin content area widens to `52rem` for more room.

**Forms (shared patterns)**
- Field groups with legends, labels, hints, and required markers (`*`).
- Inline validation (e.g. missing name/title/category).
- Primary **Create/Save** + secondary **Clear/Cancel**.
- **Tasks:** category dropdown, level chips (L1–L5), frequency radios, optional duration.
- **Categories:** color preset swatches + custom picker, description textarea, image URL with thumbnail preview.
- **Rewards:** shop vs badge radios; badge uses streak vs level with explicit controls (replaces “streak days = 0” ambiguity in the UI only — same `buildReward` rules).
- **Punishments:** trigger type radios (quota miss / manual), points lost field.

**Lists**
- Search on every catalog tab; tasks also filter by category.
- Compact cards with title, meta line, **Edit** / **Delete** (confirm on delete unchanged).
- Empty states with short guidance when nothing matches or the list is empty.
- Selected item highlighted when editing.

**Accessibility & theme**
- `min-height: 44px` on tabs, chips, inputs, and main buttons.
- Visible `:focus-visible` outlines.
- Dark purple palette preserved (`--bg-card`, `--accent`, etc.).

### Files touched

| File | Changes |
|------|---------|
| `src/pages/Admin.tsx` | Shared admin components (`AdminPanel`, `FormField`, `ChipSelect`, `RadioRow`, etc.); refactored all five tabs |
| `src/index.css` | New `.admin-*` block (~300 lines): tabs, panel grid, list cards, forms, chips, swatches, banners |

All user-facing strings added or updated are in **English**. CRUD handlers (`addCategory`, `updateTask`, `buildReward`, etc.) are unchanged.
